root_cause: Terminal delivery state changes were detected by chats, but runtime hygiene did not enforce auto-reopen/reuse of the canonical lineage; closed unmerged leased PRs could therefore strand delivery and require another chat turn.
fix: Repository janitor scans recent closed PRs for active TERMINAL_DELIVERY leases.
Closed unmerged leased PR with no successor is auto-reopened.
Exactly one same-obligation open successor is reused.
Multiple successors fail closed as lineage ambiguity.
Chats/agents refresh authority and continue instead of stopping on PR state transition.
observed_failures: Chat learning preflight failed because the regression test declared fs twice after an incremental edit.
A stale test oracle still enforced sources.length <= 64 while the canonical compiler budget had intentionally moved to 96.
Required/BRAIN admission blocked when Writer-Lease-Head referenced the prior same-lineage commit instead of the current exact head.
Protected merge correctly refused promotion while required status check test was not terminal.
additional_root_causes: Incremental test edits can duplicate imports or preserve stale assertions after canonical contract growth.
A mutable exact-head lease field becomes stale after a legitimate owner commit unless it is rebound atomically or reconciled before admission.
